n1.speaker: clarke
n1.text: Hello, is that Tom? It's Helen Clarke from Brightwell Engineering. Sorry I missed your call.

translations.fa: سلام، تام هستید؟ هلن کلارک از مهندسی برایت‌ول هستم. ببخشید تماستون را جواب ندادم.

branches.suggestion: No, sorry, Tom's out. Can I take a message?
branches.suggestionFa: نه، ببخشید، تام بیرونه. می‌تونم پیغام بگیرم؟

branches.suggestion: Tom isn't here right now. This is his friend.
branches.suggestionFa: تام الان اینجا نیست. من دوستشم.

n2.speaker: clarke
n2.text: Yes, please. Could you tell him I'm calling about the interview? We'd like to see him again.

translations.fa: بله، لطفاً. می‌شه بهش بگید دربارهٔ مصاحبه زنگ می‌زنم؟ می‌خوایم دوباره ببینیمش.

branches.suggestion: Of course. When would you like to see him?
That's great news! I'll tell him.

n3.speaker: clarke
n3.text: Next Wednesday at ten. Have you got a pen?

translations.fa: چهارشنبهٔ بعد ساعت ده. خودکار دارید؟

branches.suggestion: Just a moment… OK, I'm ready.

n4.speaker: clarke
n4.text: It's Wednesday the twelfth, ten o'clock, with me and the manager. He can ring me on 0161 496 0732.

translations.fa: چهارشنبه دوازدهم، ساعت ده، با من و مدیر. می‌تونه با ۰۱۶۱ ۴۹۶ ۰۷۳۲ باهام تماس بگیره.

branches.suggestion: Could you say the number again, please?
Wednesday the twelfth at ten. Got it.

cultureNote.en: British people often read phone numbers in groups and say "oh" for zero: "oh-one-six-one".

n5.speaker: clarke
n5.text: Of course: oh-one-six-one, four-nine-six, oh-seven-three-two. And it's Helen Clarke.

translations.fa: حتماً: صفر-یک-شش-یک، چهار-نه-شش، صفر-هفت-سه-دو. و اسمم هلن کلارکه.

branches.suggestion: Thank you, Helen. I'll pass on the message.
Thanks. He'll ring you back today.

n6.speaker: clarke
n6.text: Lovely. Thank you so much. Bye-bye!
